tracking.title: Set up tracking codes
tracking.description: Swiss Post tracking needs no account — the hub is created right away. Add parcels afterwards via the integration options or the `swiss_post.track_parcel` service.

account.title: Sign in with SwissID
account.description:
Open this link in a browser and sign in with SwissID: {authorize_url}

SwissID's final redirect is meant to open the Swiss Post mobile app, so your browser will bounce straight on to a page advertising that app — the sign-in looks like it worked, but the address containing the code never stays in the address bar. You catch it in your browser's developer tools' Network tab instead — see [step-by-step instructions]({docs_url}). Paste the full address below.

reauth_confirm.title: SwissID sign-in expired
reauth_confirm.description: Swiss Post no longer accepts the stored sign-in for {email}. Open this link, sign in again, then paste the redirect URL you catch in your browser's developer tools' Network tab (see [step-by-step instructions]({docs_url})): {authorize_url}

error.invalid_redirect: That does not look like the Swiss Post redirect URL — make sure you copied the full address, including everything after `?code=`.
error.invalid_auth: SwissID rejected this sign-in. The code is single-use and short-lived, so sign in again and copy the new address.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach SwissID. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: This Swiss Post source is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: Swiss Post was signed in again successfully.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That sign-in is for a different SwissID account. Sign in with the account this entry was set up for.

data.account_details: Include weight, size and status history

data_description.account_details: Loads the full details of every parcel in your inbox. This costs one extra request per parcel on each update, so it is off by default.

error.invalid_tracking_code: That does not look like a Swiss Post tracking code.
error.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked.
